# Code of Conduct

Yggdrasilcore is a privately managed repository. Participation happens in this
repository's issues and pull requests. There is no public chat, forum, or
Discord for this project. Upstream AzerothCore spaces are not ours and this
document does not apply there.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and stay on topic: WotLK 3.3.5a emulation, in that order.
- Give and accept constructive technical feedback.
- Do not use sexualized language or imagery, insults, slurs, personal attacks,
  harassment, or threats.
- Do not publish anyone's private information without explicit permission.

## Scope

This applies to issues, pull requests, reviews, and any other interaction in
this repository.

## Enforcement

Maintainers interpret and enforce this document. Violations are handled with,
in increasing order: a written warning, temporary exclusion from this
repository, or a permanent ban. Maintainers may remove, edit, or reject any
comment, commit, or contribution that violates it.

Report violations by contacting the repository maintainers. Reports are kept
confidential.
